deliverables: DeFi Kernel Registry Website and Submission Process
Public progress reports and final impact/work package reports
Security review or audit reports before mainnet release for smart contract workstreams
request.recipient: Dano Finance, with Minswap Labs serving as budget administrator
request.what: Dano Finance requests treasury funding to accelerate the DeFi Kernel as an open standard for shared liquidity, on-chain financial intents, and global order-book coordination on Cardano, while delivering a registry, Spot Leverage Order Book, American Options Market-Making Pools, and a Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA total, consisting of 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and a 33,000 ADA 1% administration fee for Minswap Labs.
The proposal allocates 300,000 ADA to the DeFi Kernel registry work and 1,000,000 ADA each to the Spot Leverage Order Book, American Options Protocol, and Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.

Dano Finance states that the DeFi Kernel will be an open, fee-free, and royalty-free compatibility standard whose registry does not require payment, licensing fees, certification fees, listing fees, revenue share, or smart-contract open-sourcing.

The proposal says the registry will document script hashes, datum and redeemer schemas, integration steps, supported off-chain libraries, audit or security status, TVL references, and other metadata for ecosystem integrators.
Dano Finance claims it currently has approximately USD 18M in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.

The Spot Leverage Order Book is proposed as a DeFi Kernel-compatible leveraged spot trading protocol covering collateral, borrowing, debt accounting, swap execution, risk parameters, settlement, repayment, and liquidation conditions.

The American Options Protocol is proposed as a Cardano-native American options market-making protocol using an extended concentrated-pool model with strike, expiry, premium, collateral or exposure, exercise, settlement, and LP risk accounting logic.

The SDK is proposed to support registry metadata reading, discovery helpers, metadata parsing, transaction-construction helpers, order-book and options adapters, examples, tests, and integration documentation.

The proposal sets KPIs of USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day trading volume for the Spot Leverage Order Book and USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day option notional volume for the American Options Protocol within 90 days of mainnet launch, measured using public on-chain data.

Dano Finance says it will return 5% of protocol fees from the treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, after direct transaction costs, refunds, or protocol-level settlement costs, with public reporting.

summary: The document presents a 3,333,000 ADA treasury request for Dano Finance to build DeFi Kernel registry infrastructure, two DeFi protocols, and an SDK, with Minswap Labs as administrator, milestone descriptions, KPIs, security-review requirements, repayment or non-disbursement conditions, and a 12-month 5% protocol-fee return commitment.
